rocketmq.instance.running.evidence: API 23407 documents the full state enum: running 1; expired 2, deregistered 3, unsubscribed 4, canceled 7, maintenance stopped 12, abnormal 13, overdue 15 and creation failed 101 fail a wait for running. Other transitions and unknown values remain pending. Required prodInstId identifies exactly one instance.
